snippet.title: Closed Alpha Test Announcement l NAKWON: LAST PARADISE
snippet.description:
EXIT OR DIE. Check out the teaser for NAKWON's Closed Alpha Test. 
This March, the stakes are simple: get out alive. Apply for the playtest today and join NAKWON as a Survivor. For more updates, follow our official community channels, and don't forget to wishlist the game on Steam.
​============================================================
✔️ Wishlist on Steam : https://nexon.link/bjb
✔️ Official Website: https://nakwon.nexon.com/en/teaser
✔️ Official Discord : https://discord.com/invite/nakwon
============================================================
#NAKWON #trailer #extraction
